content.title: 非限制性定语从句·which / who / whose / 介词+which 速查
content.intro: 非限制性定语从句给先行词补充'额外的、可省去的'信息,前面一定有逗号。指人用 who、指物用 which、表所属用 whose;逗号后的 which 还能指代前面一整句话。关键铁律:非限制性从句绝不能用 that。

rows: 指人作主语/宾语:Mark Twain, who was a writer, loved jokes.
指物:His wig, which is bright, makes children laugh.
表所属(……的):The girl, whose ankle hurt, cried.
some of which / many of whom / for whom:jokes, none of which were funny
He told a joke, which made everyone laugh.(which=前面整件事)

specialRules.rule: 非限制性定语从句前必有逗号,且绝不能用 that
指人 who / 指物 which;表所属一律 whose(指人指物都行)
specialRules.mark: the clown, whose nose fell off

specialRules.rule: 介词后指物用 which、指人用 whom,不能用 that 或 where
specialRules.mark: some of whom / one of which

specialRules.rule: 逗号后的 which 可指代前面一整句话,在从句中作主语或宾语
specialRules.mark: …, which means clown doctors can help.

why: 限制性从句是'缺它不可'的身份信息,不加逗号;非限制性从句只是'顺便补充',去掉后主句意思仍完整,所以用逗号隔开,而 that 语气太'紧',不能用来引导这种松散的补充说明。
gaokaoPoints: 逗号 + 空格几乎=不能填 that:指人 who、指物 which、表所属 whose 三选一。
'…, which + 谓语'指代整个主句,是写作高分句型(which means / which makes / which is why)。
介词+关系词:数量词 of which / of whom(some / many / none / both / one of …)是高频考点。

examVsReal.exam: The film, which is very funny, won a prize.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: The film's really funny — it won a prize.
examVsReal.note: 口语常拆成两句、用破折号,而书面用非限制性从句更紧凑。

examVsReal.exam: …, some of whom trained as actors（考试)
examVsReal.real: …, and some of them trained as actors
examVsReal.note: 口语爱用'and + 代词',考试更看重'介词+whom/which'的规范形式。
